---
title: "NB-02 · Descriptive Statistics & Health Metrics"
subtitle: "Module 01 — Health Analytics with R"
---

![](Images/banner_health_analytics.png){fig-align="center" width="100%"}

***
**Learning objectives**
- Compute prevalence and incidence rates with proper denominators
- Produce stratified summaries by age group, sex, and payer
- Interpret skewed distributions for LOS and hospital charges
- Apply age-standardisation (direct method) to compare populations
- Build a publication-ready descriptive "Table 1"

**Estimated time:** 1.5 hours  
**Level:** Beginner → Intermediate  
**Libraries:** `dplyr` / tibble, `stats`, `gtsummary`

## 1. Setup & Data Reconstruction


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)

# Rebuild the same synthetic dataset from NB-01 (identical seed)
set.seed(42)
N <- 500

ages  <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 62, 16), 18), 95))
sexes <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payers <- sample(
  c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
  N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03)
)
drg_codes <- sample(c(470, 291, 392, 690, 871, 193, 247, 603), N, replace = TRUE)
drg_labels_map <- c(
  `470` = "Major joint replacement", `291` = "Heart failure & shock",
  `392` = "Esophagitis/misc GI",     `690` = "Kidney/UTI",
  `871` = "Septicemia",              `193` = "Simple pneumonia",
  `247` = "Perc cardiovasc w stent", `603` = "Cellulitis"
)
los_days <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30))
charges  <- round(los_days * runif(N, 1800, 4200), 2)
charges[runif(N) < 0.08] <- NA_real_
primary_dx <- sample(
  c("E11.9", "I10", "N18.3", "I50.9", "J18.9", "A41.9", "M16.11", "N39.0"),
  N, replace = TRUE
)
admit_type <- sample(
  c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent", "Newborn"),
  N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.16, 0.02)
)

# Add comorbidities
set.seed(99)
df <- tibble(
  patient_id    = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)),
  age           = ages,
  sex           = sexes,
  payer         = payers,
  drg_code      = drg_codes,
  drg_label     = unname(drg_labels_map[as.character(drg_codes)]),
  primary_dx    = primary_dx,
  admit_type    = admit_type,
  los_days      = los_days,
  total_charge  = charges,
  diabetes      = rbinom(N, 1, 0.32),
  hypertension  = rbinom(N, 1, 0.45),
  ckd           = rbinom(N, 1, 0.15),
  heart_failure = rbinom(N, 1, 0.18),
  readmitted_30 = rbinom(N, 1, 0.14)
)

# Age groups (standard epidemiological groupings)
df$age_group <- cut(
  df$age,
  breaks = c(17, 44, 64, 74, 95),
  labels = c("18-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75+")
)

cat(sprintf("Dataset ready: %d discharges, %d variables\n", nrow(df), ncol(df)))
```

## 2. Prevalence & Incidence — Core Epidemiological Measures

| Measure | Formula | When to use |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| **Prevalence** | Cases / Total population | Existing conditions at a point in time |
| **Incidence proportion** | New cases / At-risk population | New events over a defined period |
| **Rate per N** | (Cases / Population) × N | Standardised comparisons across cohorts |


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# --- 2.1  Crude prevalence of comorbidities ---
comorbidities <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "ckd", "heart_failure")
prev_table <- tibble(
  condition       = comorbidities,
  `N cases`       = colSums(df[comorbidities]),
  `Prevalence (%)`= round(colMeans(df[comorbidities]) * 100, 1)
)
cat("Crude prevalence in discharge cohort (N=500):\n")
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# --- 2.3  95% confidence interval for a proportion (Wilson method) ---
wilson_ci <- function(k, n, alpha = 0.05) {
  # Wilson score interval — preferred for proportions near 0 or 1.
  z         <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2)
  p_hat     <- k / n
  denom     <- 1 + z^2 / n
  centre    <- (p_hat + z^2 / (2 * n)) / denom
  half_width <- (z * sqrt(p_hat * (1 - p_hat) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))) / denom
  c(
    lo = round((centre - half_width) * 100, 1),
    hi = round((centre + half_width) * 100, 1)
  )
}

ci <- wilson_ci(readmissions, total_discharges)
cat(sprintf("Readmission rate: %.1f%% (95%% CI: %s%% – %s%%)\n",
            rate_per_100, ci["lo"], ci["hi"]))
```

## 3. Stratified Summaries


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# --- 3.1  Readmission rate by payer ---
strat_payer <- df %>%
  group_by(payer) %>%
  summarise(
    N                 = n(),
    Readmissions      = sum(readmitted_30),
    `Mean LOS (days)` = round(mean(los_days), 1),
    `Mean Charge ($)` = round(mean(total_charge, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(`Readmit rate (%)` = round(Readmissions / N * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Readmit rate (%)`))
cat("Stratified by payer:\n")
```

## 4. Interpreting Skewed Clinical Distributions


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# --- 4.1  LOS skewness and kurtosis ---
skewness <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  m <- mean(x)
  s <- sd(x)
  mean((x - m)^3) / (s^3)
}
kurtosis_ex <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  m <- mean(x)
  s <- sd(x)
  mean((x - m)^4) / (s^4) - 3
}

los <- df$los_days[!is.na(df$los_days)]
chg <- df$total_charge[!is.na(df$total_charge)]

for (pair in list(list("LOS (days)", los), list("Total charge ($)", chg))) {
  name   <- pair[[1]]
  series <- pair[[2]]
  sk     <- skewness(series)
  cat(name, "\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("  Mean   : %.2f\n", mean(series)))
  cat(sprintf("  Median : %.2f\n", median(series)))
  cat(sprintf("  Std    : %.2f\n", sd(series)))
  cat(sprintf("  Skew   : %.3f  %s\n", sk,
              if (sk > 0.5) "(right-skewed — median is preferred)" else ""))
  cat(sprintf("  Kurtosis: %.3f\n\n", kurtosis_ex(series)))
}
```

## 5. Age-Standardisation (Direct Method)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Direct age-standardisation: applies study rates to a standard population
# to remove confounding by age structure differences between groups.

# US 2000 Standard Population weights by age group
std_pop <- tibble(
  age_group  = factor(c("18-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75+"),
                      levels = c("18-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75+")),
  std_weight = c(0.3761, 0.3399, 0.1267, 0.0573)   # proportions sum to ~1
)

# Crude rates by age group × payer (Medicare vs Private as example)
for (pay in c("Medicare", "Private")) {
  sub <- df %>% filter(payer == pay)
  rates <- sub %>%
    group_by(age_group) %>%
    summarise(
      crude_rate = mean(readmitted_30),
      n          = n(),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(std_pop, by = "age_group") %>%
    mutate(weighted_rate = crude_rate * std_weight)
  age_adj_rate  <- sum(rates$weighted_rate, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  crude_overall <- mean(sub$readmitted_30) * 100
  cat(sprintf("%-10s — Crude: %.1f%%  |  Age-adjusted: %.1f%%\n",
              pay, crude_overall, age_adj_rate))
}
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
Medicare   — Crude: 15.4%  |  Age-adjusted: 11.8%
Private    — Crude: 9.0%  |  Age-adjusted: 8.8%
```

## 6. Table 1 — Publication-Ready Descriptive Table

A "Table 1" in clinical research summarises the baseline characteristics of a cohort, often stratified by a key variable (e.g. readmitted vs not).


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
table1 <- function(df, stratify_col, continuous_cols, categorical_cols) {
  # Build a basic Table 1.
  # Continuous: mean ± SD (or median [IQR] if skewed)
  # Categorical: N (%)
  groups <- sort(unique(df[[stratify_col]]))
  group_label <- function(g) {
    n <- sum(df[[stratify_col]] == g, na.rm = TRUE)
    pretty <- if (identical(g, 0) || identical(g, 0L)) {
      "Not readmitted"
    } else if (identical(g, 1) || identical(g, 1L)) {
      "Readmitted"
    } else {
      as.character(g)
    }
    sprintf("%s (N=%d)", pretty, n)
  }

  rows <- list()
  header <- c(Variable = "Variable")
  for (g in groups) header[[as.character(g)]] <- group_label(g)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- header

  for (col in continuous_cols) {
    sk  <- abs(skewness(df[[col]]))
    row <- c(Variable = paste0(col, if (sk > 1) " [median, IQR]" else " [mean ± SD]"))
    for (g in groups) {
      vals <- df[[col]][df[[stratify_col]] == g]
      vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
      row[[as.character(g)]] <- if (sk > 1) {
        sprintf("%.1f [%.1f–%.1f]", median(vals), quantile(vals, 0.25), quantile(vals, 0.75))
      } else {
        sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(vals), sd(vals))
      }
    }
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row
  }

  for (col in categorical_cols) {
    row <- c(Variable = col)
    for (g in groups) row[[as.character(g)]] <- ""
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row
    cats <- unique(df[[col]][!is.na(df[[col]])])
    for (cat in cats) {
      row <- c(Variable = paste0("  ", as.character(cat)))
      for (g in groups) {
        sub   <- df[df[[stratify_col]] == g, ]
        n_cat <- sum(sub[[col]] == cat, na.rm = TRUE)
        pct   <- n_cat / nrow(sub) * 100
        row[[as.character(g)]] <- sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n_cat, pct)
      }
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row
    }
  }

  bind_rows(lapply(rows, function(r) as_tibble(as.list(r))))
}

t1 <- table1(
  df,
  stratify_col     = "readmitted_30",
  continuous_cols  = c("age", "los_days", "total_charge"),
  categorical_cols = c("sex", "payer", "admit_type", "age_group")
)
cat("Table 1 — Baseline characteristics by 30-day readmission status:\n")
```

## 7. Statistical Tests for Group Comparisons


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# --- Continuous: LOS (skewed → Mann-Whitney U) ---
g0 <- df$los_days[df$readmitted_30 == 0]
g1 <- df$los_days[df$readmitted_30 == 1]
mw <- wilcox.test(g0, g1, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("LOS — Mann-Whitney U: U=%.0f, p=%.4f\n", mw$statistic, mw$p.value))
```

```{.r .cell-code}
g0a <- df$age[df$readmitted_30 == 0]
g1a <- df$age[df$readmitted_30 == 1]
tt  <- t.test(g0a, g1a, var.equal = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Age — Student t-test: t=%.3f, p=%.4f\n", tt$statistic, tt$p.value))
```
